assets.prompt_exact: Use case: historical-scene. Asset: Steam library hero, ONE original very wide horizontal painted panorama, output requested 3840x1240 pixels; if aspect limit requires, use 3840x1280 (3:1), keeping top/bottom 20px expendable. References are style and town continuity only, independently RECOMPOSE the whole scene for panoramic format; do not crop or stretch either reference. Southern England around 1300: from a hillside a burgundy-cloaked medieval lord at the far left looks over a riverside market town. Warm late afternoon, muted olive, earth, warm plaster, terracotta, subdued blue water, hand-painted gouache grain matching the project reference. Town includes timber-frame warm-plastered houses with low rubble foundations and flat clay-tile or thatched roofs, square medieval parish church tower, canvas market stalls, wooden palisade, river and modest bridge, distant strip fields and wooded hills. Town architecture grouped across upper-left and upper-right; lower CENTER third is quiet uncluttered grass and broad water with very little focal detail, intended for Steam UI coverage. Lord only at left edge, town and bridge fully legible at panoramic scale. No title, no logo, no lettering, no numbers, no symbols, no border, no UI. CRITICAL: ALL residential roofs completely clean uninterrupted thatch or flat clay tiles, NO CHIMNEYS, NO CHIMNEY STUBS, no chimney pots, no smoke, no shiny glass, no slate, no brick houses, no hops, no bright saturated colors. Reference 2 has erroneous chimney stubs: NEVER reproduce them. Single seamless cohesive painting; no panels.

qa.history: Corrected repeated chimney stubs by whole-roof thatch replacement. No prominent residential chimneys visible in v4. Tiny light mark behind left roof ridge ambiguous foliage/highlight; visual QA is not proof of every subpixel mark.
